about: Customer-facing proposal content for the products in the first approved VIGI kit. Wording is drafted only from each product's verified catalogue specification (manufacturer pages and datasheets) and is marked provisional for Chris to review. Images are the manufacturers' own product photos (vigi.com, westerndigital.com), stored once in the CRM; the S455 photo is the one VIGI shows on the InSight S455 page. Applied once: anything already entered in the CRM is never overwritten.
